name: Setup NuGet.exe for use with actions
description: Official NuGet.exe setup action that supports cross-platform installation of specific NuGet.exe versions.

nuget-version.description: NuGet version to install. Can be `latest`, `preview`, a concrete version like `5.3.1`, or a semver range specifier like `5.x`.

nuget-api-key-source.description: Source to scope the NuGet API Key to.
